20068.overview: Take up the fiercest challenge and fight from the Oracle's island to the summit of Olympus. Hero of Sparta features an innovative double-view system combining absolute action and platforming. Face legions of enemies across eight levels of action, with the most impressive mythical creatures standing in your path -- Cerberus, the Colossus, etc. Upgrade your equipment to gain the the Chronos Sword, the Medusa Shield, and more.

27577.overview:
In “HYSTERIA PROJECT”, YOU are the hero! Step into the shoes of the main character and take part in an unforgettable adventure! Will you make the right decisions and make it out in one piece? 

Hysteria Project is a groundbreaking gaming experience where you are the hero of an entirely filmed adventure. Keep a sharp eye on what’s going on around you and most importantly of all – make the right choices at the right time. 

Recommended for fans of new experiences and thrill-seekers. 

Have you got the guts to be next on the list?

27578.overview:
You thought you had survived the nightmare... but you were wrong. 

In the wake of Hysteria Project, which received the Milthon Award in 2009 for its originality, Hysteria Project 2 sticks with the same elements that made its predecessor a success, but pushes the experience even further. 

THE GAME WHERE YOU ARE THE HERO IS BACK
-Step into the shoes of the main character and become the hero of the adventure
-Feel the fear from your character's rapid breathing and heart rate 

RICH AND VARIED GAME PLAYS
-Explore environments in 360°
-Get through laser fields and survive corridors of flames
-Solve numerous mysteries
-Pick up lots of secret documents during the adventure 

AN UNPRECEDENTED EXPERIENCE CAPTURED ENTIRELY ON FILM
-Enjoy an overwhelming soundtrack and descend into the heart of hell
-Discover a game offering the whole gamut of sensations and huge adrenaline rushes

109897.overview: This game is a unique mixture of action, RPG and simulator. Player finds himself in the world, where the air is ruled by hovering vehicles – one of which he takes under control. According to a plot, player have to fight his way through the numerous combats with monsters and accomplish different missions. During the headway to the the heart of the fairy kingdom , player’s hovering vehicle gets new weapon, armor and other useful power-ups.

127860.overview:
It sucks when you're hungry. Sometimes you just want to bury your face into a burger, or tear into a taco. Out on the African savannah, a Hungry Giraffe feels your pain.

A 20 foot tall, 1200kg animal like the giraffe needs to chow down on tons of food each day, just to stay alive. But, oh no! All the tastiest leaves have been eaten, while up in the sky endless quantities of snacks, fruit and junk food hover just out of reach!

Hungry Giraffe features the world's largest and hungriest even-toed ungulate. Through skilful steering of his neck, you can propel your half-starved giraffe on his twisty-turny upward journey, chomping on strawberries, fries, sandwiches and naughtier treats.

But beware! The skies are also strewn with hazards. Poison, Anvils and non-prescription Drugs also hover up there, ready to send unwary giraffes plummeting to earth.

Hungry Giraffe is by FAR the greatest giraffe-feeding game of all time! Dare you miss out?

133954.overview: The Ice Road Truckers is a racing game that captures the spirit and danger of the series by putting players in the driver's seat of an eighteen wheeler. Players face a number of challenges as they haul equipment and supplies to isolated outposts north of the Arctic Circle. Player take command of these huge 18-wheelers and drive their way across ice roads. Stay on the road, avoid obstacles, and reach the destination before time runs out. Quicker times earn you more money, but if you're late you won't advance !

134068.overview: Welcome to Hello Flowerz, the gardening game where you have fun with flowers. Sow your favorite flowers and look after them every day, helping them grow into healthy, beautiful flowers. Use your flowers to create wonderful bouquets and enter them in regular competitions. Landscape your own gardens, transplant flowers and arrange various items. Put on your gloves, grab your tools and start showing off your flowers!

134073.overview:
Ride the Chariots of the Gods!

The famous Heracles has take on a challenge like none he has ever faced! Our hero will have to beat his opponents in a race across mythological kingdoms and be the first to reach the top of Mount Olympus.

You can play as Heracles and help him return the sacred trophy, or play as one of the other varied mythological characters from Satyr to Poseidon and claim the prize for yourself!

Race through 3 racing cups across 10 courses set in 5 mythic landscapes and use awesome fantasy weaponry to defeat your opponents: Zeus’ lightning rods, tridents, fireballs and more!

134074.overview:
Play the classic mine sweeper game as you’ve never played it before! Hive sweeper offers unlimited number of the classic game set in the unique atmosphere of a hive. Be careful! Crazy graphics, chilling music, will soon make you a number one addict to Hive Sweeper. 

What is more!!! Have you ever got bored of playing minesweeper alone? Now with Hive Sweeper it is no longer possible! 
MULTIPLAYER mode offers you the chance to play wirelessly over Bluetooth or you can always play online if you have wifi or internet connection. Invite your friend or find an opponent via Game Center. Anyway, get ready for the ultimate battle!

Test your brain power, smartness and patience in the 3 types of game style each coming with different cell shapes. Find your challenge! In addition to the classic square board you may choose hexagon or triangle grid as well.
What is more each board type comes with 15 difficulty levels. You are the one who can set the parameters. Decide the size of your board and the number of mines! This way you can start with easy boards or really-really hard ones if you like. Adjust the time and challenge yourself. Or you need a bit more practice? Then set the unlimited time mode!

Collect your hive points to unlock all the features of the game. The more you play with the game the more hive points you get. Not patient enough? You get the chance to earn FREE hive points really easily! Not content with this? You may buy hive points for a very small amount if you wish.

Now for a limited time with 99 Hive Points for free! (Internet connection required.)

Are you an absolute beginner? Or an expert already? Hive sweeper is the mine sweeper for you!

FEATURES: 
-unique atmosphere, graphics and chilling music
-retina display support
-3 types of board: triangle, hexagon, square
-3 board sizes in each board type: small, medium, large
-you can set the time of your game or choose unlimited time-mode
-you can set the number of mines
-number of remaining mines and time display during game
-constantly breakable time record
-easy to control: zoom in-and-out with multitouch and scroll with one finger
-single tap to clear a spot, long tap to mark a flag
-smooth and fast gameplay: tap a clear spot with no surrounding mines and neighbours open automatically
-first touch guaranteed not to hit a mine
-listen to your favourite music while playing with Hive Sweeper
-Open feint supported leaderboard and challenging achievements

MULTIPLAYER options:
-play over Bluetooth or Game Center
-adjustable types of board, number of mines and time
-if your game ends you may ask for revenge

134188.overview: Step up to the plate in Homerun Hitters. Play solo or against a friend as you launch fastballs, curveballs, shoots and more! Head out to the ballpark and choose from 4 teams and play up to 9 inning in this fun back to basics baseball game.

134189.overview:
HISTORY Egypt Engineering Empire allows players to build their own empire from its foundations to the height of its power. Acting as the leader of a territory from the Egyptian Empire, players manage all aspects of its rise, from economic growth to political power, the development of armies, and expansion into other regions by war and diplomacy. 

Empires are controlled from three main views: the Campaign Map shows the entire game world, including mountains, forests, coastlines, oceans, rivers, cites, and armies. The City Map gives players an overview of the structure and role of a city within the empire, and provides a basis for economic decisions. The Battle Map is to be used when diplomacy has run its course or when a city is being attacked, resulting in turn-based combat. 

All nations, cities and armies were carefully researched to ensure historical accuracy. The game is accessible for new users, while offering deeper gameplay for expert players.

157921.overview:
Hungry bears and crazy wolves are after your flock of soft, fluffy sheep and it’s up to you and a friend to control two brave, valiant sheep dogs and protect the herd. Howl, bark or even unleash a super powered growl to scare away ferocious invaders. But bark too much and your stamina may decrease leaving you temporarily powerless to protect your cute cuddly friends. 

Recommended for two players and playable on a single PSP® system only.

164070.overview:
Lynette's conniving husband has cheated her out of her family business! What can an enterprising young woman like her do? Get revenge! Use your business savvy to help Lynette repurchase her company and send her husband to the slammer.

Buy, develop and sell commercial properties to make a profit build attractions that increase your income and keep your eye on the bottom line as you purchase materials and hire workers. The fun of Hotel Mogul will have you laughing all the way to the bank!

169460.overview: As Captain Clain, attack enemies in the air and bomb ground targets on your way to the boss in this classic shooting title originally released in 1985.

424241.overview:
The name says it all: the player controls a dragon, preying upon a medieval/fantasy kingdom in one of four game modes, laying waste to knights and castles and kidnapping princesses (for ransom!), all in the pursuit of more shiny shiny to decorate hoard sweet hoard with.

Maps are based on user selections, with geographical particularities randomized within those parameters. The player controls the dragon with two thumbsticks, one to fly and one to direct a stream of cleansing fire emerging from the dragon's mouth -- over crops, windmills, merchant carts, archers and all sorts of targets. Winnow your target down to extinction after a few fiery gasps and all that is left in their wake is a small mound of treasure, to be collected and returned to the dragon's home base on the map, its hoard, where players can heal and upgrade one of four abilities -- Speed, Breath, Treasure Capacity, and Armor -- when not defending their gold-pile from thieves and driving off would-be princess-rescuing knights.

Game modes include Treasure Hunt (a drive to maximise income in a set time limit), Princess Rush (striving to reach a set number of Princess ransoms), Survival (see how long you can survive) and Co-op.
